videos.description:
📨 Get 1% better at AI every week - https://www.jeffsu.org/newsletter/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=v210

Finding reliable #résumé advice was already hard enough, and now employers use #AI to screen applications. I break down research covering more than 4,000 hiring managers and nearly 2 million applications to show which résumé tips matter when AI is involved on both sides of hiring.

You'll learn how to make an #ATS-friendly résumé, tailor your experience to a job description without keyword stuffing, and use AI to turn rough notes into achievement bullets you can defend. We'll also cover what hiring managers actually want to see when you list AI skills.

videos.title: Why Keeping Your Options Open Backfires
videos.description:
Surfshark: Go to https://surfshark.com/solvedpod or use code SOLVEDPOD at checkout to get 4 extra months of Surfshark! AG1: For a limited time, save 20% on your first subscription order of AG1 Next Gen or AG1 Pro at https://manson.deals/ag1

Casanova had more adventures than anyone in recorded history. He escaped an inescapable prison, ran France's first lottery, slept with over 120 women, and met Voltaire, the Pope, and Benjamin Franklin. He also died broke, alone, and forgotten in a small castle in present-day Slovakia. We use his life as the cautionary tale of what Kierkegaard called the aesthetic stage, where novelty becomes an addiction and every open door is another reason to never walk through one. We talk about the paradox of choice, why your brain is hardwired to hoard options even when it costs you, and Mark's own years as a digital nomad who eventually realized that the more he explored, the less satisfied he became.

CHAPTERS
